texts.zh:
这种噪音——听起来杂糅着恐怖的轰鸣声和金属刮擦的声音——喧嚣了数秒钟，又以一声兀然的嚎叫般的噪音结尾，让在场的所有人都打了个寒颤。

正当[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]觉得这可怕的声音沉寂下去以后，它们又变本加厉地开始了。[This.Leader.GetSheHe]强忍着不适关闭了接收器。[This.Leader.GetSheHeCap]转向了聚在一起的官员们，他们中的一些甚至吓得躲到了椅背后面。
“豁，好家伙……”[This.Leader.GetSheHe]无力地说。

很难想象我们从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的这个物种发出的这些噪音没有敌意。海军官员已经做出来最坏的预计，认为我们很快就会与之交战，更冷静的声音则说我们需要再耐心地等待观察。
texts.en:
The noises - a mixture of threatening booming noises and what sounds like the grinding of metal on metal - continued unabated for several minutes, punctuated occasionally by a howling noise that sent a chill through everyone who heard it.

Just as [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] thought the noises had died down, they started up again, louder than before. With a wince, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] switched the receiver off. [This.Leader.GetSheHeCap] turned to the gathered crowd of officers, some of whom were cowering behind their seats.
"Well, that was quite something..." [This.Leader.GetSheHe] said weakly.

It is hard to imagine that a species making the noises we have picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] could be anything other than hostile. Naval officers already fear the worst and assume we will soon be at war with them, but calmer heads suggest we'd be better off waiting and seeing.

label.zh: 他们并不能决定自己发出什么样的声音。我们之后会去理解他们的。
label.en: They cannot help how they sound. We will come to understand them later.

texts.zh:
我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战社会，他们以最具威胁的战吼问候我们来测试我们的勇气。不幸的是，我们在翻译他们语言时的谨慎态度意味着他们的挑衅并没有被正面回应，使得他们得出我们是懦夫文明的结论。要改变这一第一印象需要花费我们很长时间了。
texts.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike society who greeted us with their most fearsome warcry, apparently to test our mettle. Unfortunately, our caution in translating their language meant that their challenge went unanswered, leading them to the conclusion that we are a civilization of cowards. It will take quite some time for us to live down this first impression...

texts.zh:
我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

尽管最初我们持怀疑态度，但看起来我们获取的这些信号确实就是他们的语言，只不过对于我们的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]非常地难以接受罢了。幸运的是，我们着手进行了认真的调查并回应了许多人认为的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的挑衅行为，而我们的回应也肯定会是我们摆脱与他们糟糕的开始中。这也证明了那些提倡谨慎的人的正确。
texts.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that - despite some initial doubts - the signals we picked up truly did form their language, which is simply uniquely unpalatable to our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. Fortunately, we went about investigating it in a measured manner and did respond to what many perceived to be provocation by the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a response which would surely have set us off on a poor start with them. This has vindicated those who advocated caution.

label.zh: 不要急于下结论总是好的……
label.en: It is always best not to jump to conclusions...

texts.zh:
我们的回应似乎让[This.ContactCountry.GetName]有点无语。然后很快他们彻底沉默了，之后很少再听到他们的情况。我们也只能推测其含义。

与此同时，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经在努力翻译他们语言中我们已知的部分。只要他们一有进展，我们就有希望能理解这些东西。
texts.en:
Our response seems to have left the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] quite speechless. As soon as they received it, they fell completely silent, and we have heard little from them since. We can only speculate as to the meaning of this.

In the meantime, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been hard at work translating what we know of their language. Hopefully, once they have made sufficient progress, we will be able to make sense of this.

texts.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]通过大幅度增强其传输强度以回应了我们的挑衅。现在它们吵得[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]已经不能忍受了，但是通过大幅调低音量，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]可以收集大量数据，他们相信这可能是翻译外星语言的关键——假设，在噪音的某个地方，可以发现某种语言。
texts.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] responded to our challenge by significantly increasing the intensity of their transmissions. They are now too loud for [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] to tolerate, but by turning the volume down considerably, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are able to gather a large amount of data that they believe may hold the key to translating the aliens' language - assuming that, somewhere in the noise, there is a language to be found.

texts.zh:
我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

事实证明，解释很简单，也很可怕。我们还不知道是什么原因导致了他们社会的这种发展，但事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一心一意要灭绝所有感性的，非[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]生命形式。他们认为这些人是对宇宙中所有正确和美好事物的侮辱。

这就是为什么，当他们发现我们的时候，就开始广播他们的标准问候语——战歌。我们只能认为它们的战舰会迅速跟进。
texts.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

The explanation, it turns out, is simple - and horrifying. We are not yet sure what caused this development in their society, but it turns out the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are single-mindedly determined to exterminate all sentient, non-[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] lifeforms, considering them to be an affront to all that is right and good in the universe.

This is why, when they caught sight of us, they began to broadcast their standard greeting - a warcry. We can only assume their warships will swiftly follow.

我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正如我们所料的那样是一个好战社会，他们以最具威胁的战吼问候我们来测试我们的勇气。幸运的是我们的回应获得了共鸣，我们显然获得了他们的尊重。事实上，他们认为我们作为战士的英武是仅次于他们的。
texts.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that - as we suspected - the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike society who greeted us with their most fearsome warcry, apparently to test our mettle. Fortunately, our response passed muster and we have apparently managed to earn their respect. Indeed, they seem to consider our prowess as warriors second only to theirs.

label.zh: 但愿他们永远不会被发现自己的错误！

我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

尽管最初我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]持怀疑态度，但看起来我们获取的这些信号确实就是他们的语言，只不过对于我们的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]非常地难以接受罢了。尽管我们的大多数回应尝试并没有让他们理解，但他们似乎对我们的拙劣模仿感到被冒犯，特别是因为我们不幸地反复发出了一个和他们语言中最粗鲁的羞辱非常相似的声音。要改变这一第一印象需要花费我们很长时间了。
texts.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that - despite the initial skepticism of our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] - the signals we picked up truly did form their language, which is simply uniquely unpalatable to our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. While most of our attempted response did not make a great deal of sense to them, it seems that they are somewhat insulted by our poor imitation, especially since we had the misfortune to - repeatedly - make a sound that is very similar to one of the crudest insults used in their language. It will take quite some time for us to live down this first impression...

label.zh: 好。我们就没想过要做他们的朋友。
label.en: Good. We never intended to be their friends.
